description.zh: 箭头与分量、首尾相接的向量加法、数乘与减法、点积与投影，并用绳子受力平衡和过河的相对速度两个例子应用。二维直角坐标。
description.en: Arrows and components, head-to-tail vector addition, scaling and subtraction, the dot product and projection, applied to rope-force equilibrium and relative velocity when crossing a river. Two-dimensional Cartesian coordinates.

label.zh: 本页是该节点的互动讲解
label.en: This page is an interactive lesson on that node

reason.zh: 首尾相接与分量加法是同一种加法的两种画法——本页把它们并排演示，落到同一个“向量”节点上。
reason.en: Head-to-tail and by-components are two drawings of the same addition — this lesson shows them side by side, landing on the single 'vectors' node.

label.zh: 力的平衡是向量和为零
label.en: Force balance is a vector sum of zero

reason.zh: 第 4 步把三个力画成首尾相接的闭合三角形，T₁ + T₂ + W = 0。
reason.en: Step 4 draws three forces as a closed head-to-tail triangle, T₁ + T₂ + W = 0.

title.zh: 几个力合在一起怎么算？

ask.zh: 向量加法首尾相接——两个力方向相同、相反时，合力各是多少？
ask.en: Vector addition joins arrows head to tail — for two forces in the same direction, and in opposite directions, what is each resultant?

ask.zh: 绳子受力平衡时，几个力的合力是多少？合力为零意味着什么？
ask.en: When rope forces balance, what is their resultant? What does a zero resultant mean?

reveal.zh: 力按矢量相加：首尾相接画箭头，合力是起点到终点的箭头；合力为零就是平衡。
reveal.en: Forces add as vectors: join arrows head to tail and the resultant runs from start to finish; a zero resultant is balance.

note: conceptId suffixed because atlas already has a node "vectors" (collision); this fragment’s edges attach to that existing node as a connection.
